review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed 960x803 RGB checkpoint tiles before any M3M model outputs or development inference. Projected cuboids corrected to visible 2D extents.
review.scope: Sparse selected checkpoints, not exhaustive object labels or independent human certification. Physical approach labels unchanged and relative to camera, not object self-motion. Dark and image-truncated visible objects retained.
review.selection: Two disjoint four-second intervals preregistered from timestamps and cadence, same recording/domain as earlier studies. No input, checkpoint or candidate selected from inference outcomes.

omissions.boreas-m3m-turn-05.2: Projected vehicle lies behind foreground black Hyundai; no separately identifiable visible extent can be assigned.

omissions.boreas-m3m-turn-08.2: Projected vehicle lies inside foreground Hyundai body/windscreen; separately identifiable 2D extent unavailable.
omissions.boreas-m3m-turn-08.4: Projected distant vehicle falls in foreground Hyundai windscreen; separately identifiable visible extent unavailable.

review.omissionDisposition: All original candidates remain in candidates.json; omissions are unscorable visibility cases, not correct abstentions or successful negatives. Frozen before inference.
